casr._alignment_comment: Mirrors deploy/real_lmcache_pd/router_config.json: the same FlowSolverConfig keys with the same semantics.  prefill/decode_service_ms are the single-request service times implied by each instance's capacity at the run's --max-num-seqs 64 (service_ms = 1000 * max_num_seqs / capacity), so compute_weight prices per-unit compute the way the real control loop does.
casr._service_comment: prefill/decode service_ms and capacities are Qwen3-8B placeholders: rescale_service_times/rescale_capacities overwrite them from profiler/perf/<HW>/casr/P15B/bf16.
casr._slo_comment: SLO-priced twin of the fixed three-Prefill pool: TTFT <= 1500 ms, +10 per unit of flow on any (class, prefill, decode) triple whose predicted TTFT misses it; per-class budgets from the trace override this and the tightest wins.  Run it against workloads/matrix-<peak>rps-slo1500.jsonl.  The budget is 3x the interactive 500 ms on purpose: at these peaks 500 ms is below the pool's own service floor, so *every* pair violates and the penalty becomes a constant that changes nothing (measured 2026-09-23, docs/实验数据集与对比基线说明.md 6.22).
casr._fabric_comment: wan fabric: same-host push 0.257 GB/s, cross-host push 0.11 GB/s + 48 ms RTT, local_prefill auto, container start 45 s
casr._prefill_queue_comment: Prefill-side queue price (10.0).  Without it a producer sitting at exactly its priced capacity looks free, so a saturated plan pins every producer at 100% and the capacity error becomes an unbounded queue.  Measured 2026-09-24: P-15B metro 3674 -> 2395 ms (SLO 59.5% -> 100%), P-15B WAN p50 5894 -> 3927 ms, Qwen3 unchanged.
casr._link_comment: Per-producer KV push split by pairing: the same-domain path is the measured 257 MB/s host push, the wire path is the inter-domain fabric.  One budget for both charged same-domain handoffs at the cross-domain rate and capped the fastest producer below what it executes (measured 2026-09-24: priced 5.19 req/s against 8.3 executed).

_comment: P-15B (casr/P15B) on the same three-domain topology as casr_real_qwen3_8b_three_domain.json, so the two are directly comparable: same nodes, same links, same instances -- only the model and its KV geometry differ. kv_bytes_per_token is the design's closed form (16960 B = 16.56 KB/token, docs/DSV4-P15B设计.md 5), against 147456 B for Qwen3-8B.  |  Fixed three-Prefill pool: the placement-only counterpart of the load/cache_aware baselines (they use the same three workers).  |  SLO-priced twin (ttft_slo_ms=1500, slo_penalty=10); pair it with workloads/matrix-<peak>rps-slo1500.jsonl.  |  wan fabric variant (producer-push rates).
_intra_link_comment: Intra-domain fabric: 1 GB/s, 2 us.  Without these two keys the pair-cost table gives same-node pairs zero bandwidth, so the router's recompute-vs-transfer price silently falls back to the recorded deployment constants (see 实验数据集与对比基线说明.md 6.15).
